Bring It

You are a recent graduate in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field. You bring strong English communication skills and experience with Excel and Adobe Creative Suite. Some web development knowledge is a bonus, but your analytical thinking matters most.

description:
Head of Growth & Revenue




Senior E-Commerce & CPG Growth Strategist

Employment Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Work Arrangement: Remote

Schedule: U.S. Business Hours – 4–5 hours of daily overlap with Arizona Mountain Standard Time (MST, UTC−7).




About US

Talent Global is a global recruitment partner connecting exceptional remote professionals with fast-growing international companies. We specialize in connecting top talent with opportunities across marketing, growth, e-commerce, and technology.




About the Client Company

Our client is a fast-growing, female-founded consumer wellness brand specializing in innovative wearable vitamin patches designed to make everyday wellness simpler and more accessible.

The company operates across multiple sales channels, including direct-to-consumer e-commerce, Amazon, retail, and strategic partnerships, with an expanding product portfolio and ambitious growth plans.




About the Role

We are looking for a commercially minded, data-driven Head of Growth & Revenue to lead the company's overall revenue growth strategy.

This is a senior leadership position for someone who understands how to scale CPG and DTC consumer brands, identify high-impact revenue opportunities, and translate business data into measurable growth strategies.




You will work directly with the Founder & CEO, taking ownership of revenue performance across multiple channels, including Shopify, Amazon, wholesale, retail, affiliates, and new product launches.

This is not a hands-on social media or paid advertising execution role. Instead, you will be responsible for setting strategic priorities, leading growth initiatives, coordinating specialists, and ensuring that marketing and commercial efforts translate into profitable revenue.




Key Responsibilities

Develop and lead the company's overall revenue growth strategy across DTC, Amazon, wholesale, retail, affiliates, and new product launches.
Drive customer acquisition strategies across Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, creator partnerships, affiliates, and organic channels.
Develop customer retention strategies to increase repeat purchases, subscription adoption, customer loyalty, and lifetime value (LTV).
Analyze and optimize the Shopify customer journey, including conversion rates, landing pages, product pages, checkout performance, upsells, bundles, and average order value (AOV).
Identify product positioning, merchandising, promotional, and pricing opportunities based on sales data and customer behavior.
Lead commercial planning and revenue forecasting for new product launches and new SKUs.
Coordinate and manage growth specialists, agencies, and external partners across paid media, email/SMS, creative, and affiliate marketing.
Build and maintain revenue dashboards and performance reporting systems to track KPIs such as CAC, ROAS, MER, conversion rate, AOV, LTV, repeat purchase rate, and contribution margin.
Identify opportunities to expand sales channels, strategic partnerships, marketplaces, and retail distribution.
Lead weekly revenue performance reviews, evaluate results against targets, identify growth opportunities, and prioritize experiments based on profitability and business impact.
Work closely with the Founder & CEO to establish revenue goals, growth priorities, and long-term commercial strategies.




Requirements

6+ years of experience in e-commerce, growth marketing, revenue strategy, or commercial growth roles.
Proven experience scaling physical consumer product brands, ideally within CPG, wellness, beauty, supplements, or lifestyle industries.
Strong knowledge of Shopify and the DTC e-commerce customer journey.
Demonstrated success driving revenue growth while maintaining a strong focus on profitability, customer acquisition costs, and retention.
Solid working knowledge of Meta Ads, Google Ads, Klaviyo, email/SMS marketing, affiliate marketing, and conversion rate optimization.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate marketing and sales performance data into actionable growth strategies.
Experience planning and leading product launches, including revenue forecasts, channel strategies, and performance measurement.
Experience managing or coordinating marketing teams, external specialists, agencies, or strategic partners.
Strong financial understanding, including gross margin, contribution margin, CAC, ROAS, and customer lifetime value (LTV).
Experience building revenue forecasts, performance dashboards, and structured growth roadmaps.
Excellent English communication skills, with the ability to confidently present strategic recommendations and business insights to executive leadership.
Ability to work independently, prioritize initiatives, and take ownership of measurable business outcomes.




Important: Candidates must be able to provide concrete examples of brands they have personally helped grow, including starting revenue, ending revenue, timeframe, key growth strategies implemented, and how profitability was considered.




Nice to Have

Experience scaling consumer brands from approximately $1M to $5M+ in annual revenue.
Experience growing Amazon marketplaces, wholesale accounts, and omnichannel CPG businesses.
Experience scaling subscription-based or replenishment-focused products.
Familiarity with Shopify Analytics, GA4, Klaviyo, TikTok Shop, Faire, and attribution/reporting tools.
Experience with specialty retail, creator-driven commerce, and strategic partnerships.
Understanding of inventory planning, product launch economics, and promotional impact on profit margins.
Experience using AI tools for growth research, analytics, experimentation, and workflow optimization.




What We're Looking For

We are looking for a strategic growth leader who understands the full commercial picture of a consumer brand, not just individual marketing channels.

The ideal candidate is analytical, commercially driven, proactive, and comfortable working directly with a founder in a fast-paced environment. Someone who can identify where the biggest growth opportunities are, build a clear strategy, lead execution through a team, and take accountability for measurable revenue results.




This is a full-time, long-term, exclusive opportunity. We are not looking for freelance consultants, fractional advisors, or agency strategists. The selected candidate will be fully dedicated to the company, working 40 hours per week with 4–5 hours of daily overlap with Arizona Mountain Standard Time (UTC−7).

Construir una marca relevante, reconocida y cercana para profesionales y entusiastas de la panadería y repostería, integrando en una sola estrategia:




* Posicionamiento de marca.

Posicionamiento de marca




* Desarrollar y ejecutar la estrategia de marca de Baking Alchemy.

* Medir el desempeño de promociones y acciones en punto de venta.

* Administrar catálogo, promociones, contenidos, inventarios y experiencia de compra.

* Implementar estrategias para aumentar tráfico, conversión, ticket promedio y recompra.

* Coordinar campañas de performance, marketplaces y automatizaciones comerciales.

* Analizar métricas y proponer mejoras continuas al embudo digital.




Redes sociales y contenido




* Crear y administrar el calendario de contenidos.

* Desarrollar publicaciones, campañas, videos, recetas y materiales educativos.

* Coordinar colaboraciones con chefs, reposteros, creadores de contenido y comunidades.

* Gestionar la interacción con usuarios y fortalecer la comunidad digital.

* Medir alcance, engagement, generación de demanda y conversión.




¿Qué buscamos?




* Licenciatura en Marketing, Comunicación, Publicidad, Negocios, Diseño o áreas relacionadas.

* Experiencia deseable en alimentos, productos de consumo, retail o Food Service.

* Manejo de redes sociales, plataformas de e-commerce, marketplaces y herramientas de análisis.

* Experiencia coordinando campañas digitales y acciones en punto de venta.

* Conocimientos de Meta Ads, Google Ads, CRM, email marketing y analítica digital.

* Inglés intermedio deseable.




Competencias clave




* Creatividad con enfoque comercial.

* Pensamiento estratégico y capacidad de ejecución.

* Sensibilidad por la marca y atención al detalle.

* Organización y seguimiento disciplinado.

* Capacidad para analizar datos y convertirlos en acciones.

* Mayor reconocimiento y preferencia de marca.

description:
Acerca de Contalink

En Contalink estamos revolucionando la forma de hacer contabilidad en México. Nuestra plataforma en la nube ayuda a contadores a automatizar sus procesos, ahorrar un 80% de tiempo, atender más clientes con menos esfuerzo y brindar información financiera valiosa para que las empresas tomen mejores decisiones.

Sin embargo nuestro visión va mucho más allá buscando es ser el backbone financiero ayudando a las PYMES a tener información inmediata y libertad del trabajo tedioso con automatización, para que se enfoquen así en ser más rentables , crecer y dedicar más tiempo su familia y sus pasiones

Somos una startup en rápido crecimiento, respaldada por un grupo de inversionistas de todo el mundo entre los que destacan YCombinator, Scribble , FoundersX, Liquid2Ventures y 500 Startups entre muchos otros.

Este año sobrepasamos los 10M USD de ARR en ventas y seguimos creciendo muy fuerte para llegar a nuestro objetivo de alcanzar 100M USD de ARR al 2030. Actualmente atendemos a aproximadamente 25.000 clientes, quienes a su vez administran a más de 400.000 contribuyentes en nuestra plataforma. Somos una de las empresas de Software propietario más grande del país.




Acerca del rol

En Contalink buscamos a una persona con experiencia en creación de contenido especializado, conocimiento del sector contable y una gran capacidad para conectar con audiencias profesionales.

Tu misión será convertir a Contalink en una fuente de información de referencia para los contadores en México, creando contenido relevante, útil y confiable que ayude a los profesionales a mantenerse actualizados, resolver problemas y mejorar la manera en que trabajan.

No buscamos crear publicaciones únicamente para hablar de nuestro producto. Queremos construir una comunidad que encuentre tanto valor en nuestro contenido que regrese, participe y lo recomiende.




¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

Serás responsable de investigar, desarrollar y distribuir contenido que posicione a Contalink como una marca de referencia dentro de la comunidad contable.

Para lograrlo, trabajarás en cuatro áreas principales:

1. Investigación y estrategia editorial

Identificar tendencias, reformas fiscales, noticias y temas relevantes para contadores.
Investigar las necesidades, dudas y desafíos de los profesionales contables.
Diseñar una agenda editorial que combine temas de actualidad con contenido de valor a largo plazo.
Entrevistar a contadores y especialistas para desarrollar contenido con perspectivas y ejemplos reales.
Verificar fuentes y datos para asegurar la precisión de la información publicada.

2. Creación de contenido especializado

Redactar artículos, guías prácticas, newsletters y publicaciones para redes sociales.
Transformar temas contables, fiscales y financieros complejos en contenido claro, atractivo y fácil de comprender.
Desarrollar guiones y crear contenido narrado en formatos de audio y video.
Crear piezas gráficas sencillas y colaborar con Diseño cuando el contenido lo requiera.
Adaptar una misma investigación a distintos formatos y plataformas.

3. Crecimiento y desarrollo de audiencia

Gestionar el calendario editorial de LinkedIn, blog, newsletters y otros canales.
Identificar oportunidades para colaborar con expertos, profesionales y comunidades contables.
Desarrollar contenido que incentive conversaciones, participación y recomendaciones.
Convertir las preguntas e intereses de la audiencia en nuevas oportunidades de contenido.
Implementar iniciativas que impulsen el crecimiento de suscriptores y lectores recurrentes.

4. Análisis y optimización

Medir el desempeño del contenido e identificar qué temas y formatos generan mayor interés.
Analizar métricas de alcance, engagement, suscripciones y retención de audiencia.
Experimentar con nuevos enfoques, formatos y estrategias de distribución.
Utilizar los resultados para mejorar continuamente la estrategia editorial.




¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia creando contenido especializado para audiencias profesionales. Como referencia, buscamos al menos 3 años de experiencia relevante.
Conocimiento sólido en temas contables y fiscales, así como comprensión de los desafíos de los contadores en México.
Excelente redacción, ortografía y habilidad para explicar información técnica de manera sencilla.
Experiencia creando artículos, publicaciones, guiones y contenido para distintos canales.
Capacidad para investigar, contrastar fuentes y desarrollar contenido confiable.
Experiencia utilizando métricas para mejorar el rendimiento del contenido.
Manejo de herramientas de diseño y edición que permitan producir contenido de manera autónoma.
Portafolio que demuestre la calidad de tu trabajo y experiencia desarrollando audiencias.




Será un plus si:

Formación académica o experiencia profesional en Contaduría.
Experiencia en periodismo especializado, medios financieros o comunidades profesionales.
Conocimientos de SEO, email marketing y distribución de newsletters.
Experiencia creando contenido en video y desenvolviéndote frente a cámara.
Experiencia utilizando herramientas de inteligencia artificial para investigación y creación de contenido, siempre con criterio y verificación.




Modalidad de trabajo

🌎 100% remoto, bajo una cultura digital-first.

Tenemos reuniones presenciales en nuestra oficina de Monterrey, Nuevo León, aproximadamente una semana por trimestre. Los gastos relacionados con traslado y hospedaje son cubiertos por Contalink.




Beneficios de trabajar en Contalink

Compensación competitiva acorde a tu experiencia y nivel de seniority.
$2,000 MXN mensuales adicionales en vales de despensa y apoyo para trabajo desde casa.
Vacaciones disponibles desde tu ingreso y día libre para celebrar tu cumpleaños.
Seguro de gastos médicos mayores, acompañamiento psicológico a través de Terapify y acceso a gimnasios a través de TotalPass.
Libros y recursos de aprendizaje para apoyar tu desarrollo profesional, cubiertos por Contalink.




¿Por qué unirte a Contalink?

Tendrás la oportunidad de construir una estrategia de contenido con impacto real, dentro de una empresa tecnológica en crecimiento.

Buscamos a alguien que no solo ejecute ideas, sino que proponga, experimente y tome decisiones para desarrollar una comunidad profesional cada vez más grande.

Tu trabajo ayudará a miles de contadores a mantenerse informados, mejorar sus prácticas profesionales y descubrir nuevas maneras de trabajar.




¡Nos encantará conocerte! 🚀

Postúlate y construyamos juntos una de las comunidades de contenido contable más relevantes de México.

Job Description

The Social Media Analyst runs the daily operation of Cemex's global corporate social media channels, from planning through publication, paid promotion, and monitoring.

Working with External Comms leadership, the role brings the social strategy to life through the editorial calendar, manages paid campaigns within budget, and monitors online conversation about Cemex and the industry.

Its goal is a consistent, well-managed presence that strengthens Cemex's narrative and earns visible engagement with its key audiences.

Main Responsibilities


Strategy execution: Put the established social media strategy into practice across Cemex’s corporate channels, making sure each platform meets its KPIs and adapting to trends and algorithm changes.
Content intake and calendar: Receive content from the team and contribute with proposals to the monthly editorial calendar.
Scheduling and publishing: Run final QA on copy, visuals, links and tags, schedule posts, and verify everything goes live correctly.
Paid media: Create paid campaigns and put spend behind published content within the approved budget, adjusting targeting to hit performance goals.
Monitoring and community management: Watch platforms daily, respond to comments and messages, and flag sensitive conversations or underperforming posts early, escalating per approved guidelines.
Performance reporting: Analyze results by platform and content to understand what drives engagement, and prepare clear reports and insights for stakeholders.
Network support: Act as the social media point of contact for Business Units and corporate areas, offering technical support, guidance and best practices for their channels.


Position Challenges


Keep daily publishing accurate and on time across several platforms.
Spot sensitive conversations early and escalate them quickly and with sound judgment.
Get the most from a fixed paid budget across platforms, markets and languages, and show its return.
Manage requests from Corporate Communications, Business Units and corporate areas with competing priorities.
Keep up with constant platform and algorithm changes.
Key competencies: Planning and organization, attention to detail, analytical thinking, stakeholder management.


Qualifications


Languages
Spanish: native or full professional proficiency.
English: advanced (C1 or higher), written and spoken.
Academic background
Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business or a related field, or equivalent professional experience in those areas

description:
Haus of Tiles, LLC · Remote · Written support only.

About Haus of Tiles

Haus of Tiles is a design-first mahjong lifestyle brand based in Dripping Springs, Texas. We make tile sets, mats, racks and accessories that are meant to be mixed, matched and left out on display. Our tiles are deeply engraved and then painted by machine, by hand or both, and every collection is designed by our co-founder Jenna, who is an interior designer.

We launched in April 2026, and the response has been bigger and faster than we planned for. We are a small team run by two co-founders, working with manufacturing partners overseas and a fulfillment partner in Austin.

Our customers care a lot about what they buy. Many of them are planning game nights, buying gifts, or waiting on a pre-order for a set they have been watching for months. They deserve someone on the other end who knows the product and actually follows through.

About the role

Right now, one of our co-founders answers nearly every customer message himself. We are looking for the first person to own customer support with us and to help shape how it works as we grow.

Most of your day will be written conversations with customers by email, through our help desk, and in Instagram and Facebook messages, with other channels likely to be added over time. There is no phone support.

This is not a script-reading job. Plenty of what comes in is routine: order status, shipping rates, product sizes, restock timing. The part we really need help with is everything else. A tracking number that hasn't moved in a week. A rack that arrived cracked and photos that won't upload. An address that looks like a mix-up. A customer who has been waiting on a delayed pre-order and is running out of patience. Those take judgment, some digging across Shopify, our help desk and our fulfillment partner, and a reply that sounds like a real person who cares how it turns out.

You will also be the person who sees patterns first. If the same question keeps coming in, we want you to tell us why and help fix it at the source, whether that means rewriting an FAQ, updating a saved reply, flagging a product page that is confusing people, or suggesting a better process with our warehouse.

What you'll do

Answer customer emails, help desk tickets and social media messages promptly, in a warm, clear voice that fits our brand
Handle order questions, including status, tracking, address changes, cancellations and returns, following our policies and knowing when a decision should come to us
Look into shipping problems such as stalled tracking, lost packages and international duties, and stay with them alongside our fulfillment partner and the carriers until there is an answer

Keep pre-order and restock customers informed honestly, including when timing moves

Track recurring issues and bring us clear, practical ideas for fixing them
Help build and maintain our support playbook as policies change
Use AI drafting tools where they help, and catch it when a draft gets the facts or the tone wrong

At least two years in customer support or customer success, ideally with an ecommerce or direct-to-consumer brand
Hands-on experience with a ticketing or help desk system and a solid understanding of how a support process should run

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Bridge, a Stripe company, is a rapidly growing business and the number of developers integrating our APIs is growing quickly. We partner with developers to understand their use cases and guide them in integrating with our APIs. We’re a small but mighty team that’s expanding global coverage and is looking to make our first Activation Specialists hires in Mexico City.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll work directly with developers as they integrate with Bridge APIs, guiding them through the onboarding process and helping them go live successfully. You’ll play a key role in resolving early-stage technical challenges, ensuring a smooth activation experience, and accelerating time-to-value for our customers.

As an Activation Specialist, you’ll collaborate across Product, Solutions Engineering, and Support teams to unblock customers, improve onboarding workflows, and ensure high-quality handoffs. Beyond day-to-day activation support, you’ll contribute to the growth of our onboarding operation- enhancing areas such as workflow optimization, documentation, tooling, metrics, and reporting. This is a high-impact role with visibility across the business, ideal for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working with developers, and improving processes at scale.

A Few Key Features Include


Specialized experts: Activation specialists provide experience helping customers integrate Bridge technology in various use cases
Project management consists of a kick off call, regular check-ins, Slack Q&A to help unblock your team.
Product workshops and training for Bridge’s dashboard



Responsibilities


Proactively providing technical guidance and support to users during their onboarding journey with Bridge.
Deliver pre-built technical workshops and kick off calls to users.
Provide light touch project management for ongoing Bridge implementations and timely escalate any delays with planned go-live dates.

Continuously updating knowledge of Bridge’s products, features, and updates.
Escalating complex technical issues to appropriate teams for resolution.
Providing exceptional customer service to ensure a positive onboarding experience for users.
Contributing to the improvement of onboarding processes and documentation.



Who you are

We are looking for dynamic and curious people that have a passion for solving global user issues, building operations, driving process improvements and want to play a front-line role in building this new operational capability for Bridge and accelerating Bridge’s growth. If you like challenging, scaled problems and are an amazing teammate, we want to hear from you!

The Onboarding Specialist is responsible for providing technical guidance to users during their onboarding journey with Bridge. They proactively address technical queries, troubleshoot issues, and provide solutions to ensure a seamless onboarding process. They work closely with users to understand their needs, offer guidance on best practices, and anticipate and address any potential technical challenges. The Onboarding Specialist collaborates with cross-functional teams, escalates issues as needed, and maintains accurate records of user interactions. Their goal is to provide exceptional customer service and ensure that users have a positive and successful onboarding experience with Bridge.

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


2+ years of implementation consulting in API technologies or other complex technical environments.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Strong technical understanding of APIs and experience with SaaS solutions.
Comfortable talking about technical concepts, and explaining how Bridge works, both from a product features and API architecture perspective.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to effectively engage and influence various stakeholders.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple onboarding flows concurrently.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with financial systems, online payments, or e-commerce platforms.
Experience delivering live technical training to users.
Comfortable with various code-level debugging & writing of code.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

description:

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US 

Service Delivery Consultants are skilled professionals who form part of our SaaS Operations team delivering services to our clients. The main purpose of the role is to ensure the effective support and maintenance of SimCorp Dimension and to all aspects of service delivery around SimCorp Dimension.

Service Delivery Consultants support our clients by providing solutions and deploying services related to the usage of SimCorp Dimension. They work closely with local and global teams within SimCorp. They instruct, coach and mentor less experienced consultants.

In this key role you will in NA to provide support & solutions to overcome issues encountered by the customer and to optimise usage of the systems for them. This interesting job offers you a valuable opportunity to increase your knowledge and gain experience on a variety of disciplines. You will find yourself working in a fast-growing environment for an international company with significant growth potential and career opportunities. If you want to contribute to our development in a professional environment - grow with us!

What You Will Be Responsible For


 You will be the key contact for our clients regarding production support and oversee the relationship.
 Establish and maintain a network at several levels at the client incl. management and be regarded as a trusted advisor by the client to promote a mutually beneficial long-term partnership
 Analyse problems and issues which occur in the solutions and the system operations of SimCorp services at clients’ production environment on a wide range of topics with professional expertise to provide convincing and timely solutions to our client within agreed SLAs
 Advise and service our client users professionally on configuration maintenance and enhancement by providing solutions related to the usage of SimCorp services and beyond to ensure that the client uses SimCorp services in an optimal, future-oriented way
 Co-operate closely with other professionals within SimCorp on a global level by way of specialist roles to share knowledge and ensure efficient solutions for the client
 Act as a coach or mentor and review work of others. Guide others regarding general practices and procedures within own field
 You will be required to work on [NA] shift. Weekend/Public Holiday works are required on occasion. Working extended hours might also be required on occasion.


WHAT WE VALUE:

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest.


 A degree in finance/economics/mathematics/computer science. Knowledge in financial issues - theoretical as well as practical
 Minimum 5 years’ experience within asset management, funds management or custodian.
 Experience in the operation and support of front-to-back investment management solutions
 You are good at working on & prioritizing multiple tasks at the same time.
 Forward-thinking, service-minded and a natural drive for problem solving, motivated, committed, result-oriented, and able to thrive when faced with tight deadlines
 Effective client communication and presentation skills including listening skills, and fluency in English (spoken and written)


Benefits

Attractive salary and bonus scheme are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an work & private life balance: a hybrid workplace model and extra days of vacation. We also practice a tailored approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take

NEXT STEP

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients

Working Model: Hybrid

Solution Support Expert

Do you want to work in a global company where you can contribute to a more sustainable food production?

DeLaval is a leading developer, manufacturer and supplier of solutions for dairy farmers around the world. Through innovation, technology, and a strong commitment to animal welfare and farm profitability, we help our customers improve productivity while creating a more sustainable future for dairy farming.

DeLaval is now looking for a Solution Support Expert

In this role, you will act as the consultative owner of an assigned Aftermarket or Capital Goods portfolio, driving recommendations that influence market positioning, profitability, adoption, and long-term portfolio success. You will connect customer insights, market trends, commercial opportunities, and business performance to shape portfolio decisions throughout the product lifecycle.As a senior individual contributor, you will work across Product Management, Sales, Marketing, Service, and market organizations to support portfolio growth, strengthen customer value propositions, and ensure successful commercialization of solutions.

This role requires strong commercial acumen, cross-functional influence, and the ability to translate complex market and customer needs into actionable recommendations.

This position will be based in Querétaro, Mexico.

Own and drive recommendations for an assigned portfolio throughout the product lifecycle.

Prioritize customer and field feedback to improve portfolio performance and customer value.
Support pricing, positioning, and go-to-market strategies.

Develop business cases, forecasts, and portfolio performance analyses.
Build strong relationships with customers, dealers, and internal stakeholders.

Collaborate across functions to influence roadmap, commercialization, and investment decisions.

Bachelor's degree in Agriculture-related courses, Veterinary Medicine, Animal Science, or a related field.

Strong commercial and analytical capabilities, including business case development and market assessment.
Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive outcomes in cross-functional environments.
Experience working with customer insights, market analysis, pricing, and portfolio performance.
Ability to communicate complex concepts to commercial, technical, and customer audiences.

Additional language skills.

Únete a nuestra misión de liderar el futuro de Snacking. Hazlo posible.

title: Diseñador de contenido digital y multimedia
description:
EMPRESA Plaza Comercial

UBICACIÓN Centro de Monterrey, Nuevo León

MODALIDAD Presencial

ÁREA Marketing y Comunicación

REPORTA A Coordinador(a) de Marketing y administrador

COLABORA CON Diseñadora, influencer invitada y locatarios




Contexto de la plaza

La plaza va dirigida a un mercado urbano de experiencias en el Centro de Monterrey con giros de tecnología, servicios y reparaciones, moda, accesorios y gastronomía. Compite con plazas grandes de precio y volumen que casi no tienen presencia digital como destino. Esa es nuestra oportunidad: el contenido debe llevar gente a la plaza y mostrar a los locatarios y a los futuros arrendatarios es el lugar donde se vende.




Objetivo del puesto

Crear y producir el contenido (video, fotografía y diseño) que posicione a la plaza como destino en Monterrey, aumente la afluencia de visitantes, dé visibilidad real a los locatarios y genere material que facilite la comercialización de nuevos locales. Reporta al Coordinador de Marketing y administrador, ejecuta el calendario de contenidos y eventos de la plaza.




Responsabilidades principales




Producción audiovisual y contenido de destino (prioridad del puesto)

· Micro-historias de locatarios: producir reels, TikToks e historias que cuenten el negocio, el producto estrella y a la persona detrás del local. Se busca generar identidad y confianza, no solo anuncios.

· Cobertura de eventos y activaciones: fotografiar y grabar los eventos de la plaza y entregar piezas listas para publicar en los tiempos que defina el coordinador.

· Contenido con la influencer: acompañar sus visitas (locaciones, locatarios, guion básico) y editar o adaptar el material que se genere para los distintos canales.

· Contenido de ubicación y experiencia: mostrar cómo llegar (metro, camión, avenidas), qué se encuentra en cada módulo y cómo se vive la plaza.

· Banco de contenido: organizar fotos, videos y materiales por local, módulo, giro y fecha, de modo que cualquier pieza se pueda reutilizar.




Diseño gráfico y marca

· Diseñar piezas para eventos, promociones, locales y comunicación institucional, aplicando el manual de identidad de la plaza (paleta, tipografías, logotipo y eslogan “seguro vendes”).

· Desarrollar material para pantallas, señalización y publicidad dentro de la plaza, y adaptar cada pieza a los formatos de cada canal.

· Apoyar el mapa digital de locales con códigos QR (ficha por local: producto estrella, horario y contacto).

· Trabajar en conjunto con la diseñadora del equipo, repartiendo la carga de trabajo según el calendario del coordinador.




Redes sociales y comunidad

· Ejecutar el calendario de contenidos y programar publicaciones en Instagram, Facebook y TikTok mediante Meta Business Suite.

· Dar seguimiento a comentarios, mensajes y consultas, y canalizar las solicitudes comerciales o administrativas al área correspondiente.

· Apoyar el programa de reseñas en Google Maps y mantener actualizada la información de la plaza en ese canal.

· Reportar cada mes al coordinador alcance, vistas de video, interacción y crecimiento, y proponer qué formatos repetir, ajustar o dejar de producir.




Comercialización y activaciones

· Producir material para promover la renta de locales disponibles: recorridos en video, fotografías de los módulos y de la plaza en operación, y casos de locatarios para mostrar a prospectos.

· Colaborar en la ejecución de campañas, eventos y activaciones de bajo presupuesto que prolonguen la permanencia y aumenten las visitas.

· Coordinar con los locatarios la producción de contenido, calendarizando grabaciones sin afectar su operación.




REQUISITOS:

· Licenciatura o carrera técnica en Diseño Gráfico, Comunicación, Mercadotecnia, Producción Audiovisual o afín.

· Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en producción y edición de video corto y creación de contenido digital, comprobable con portafolio.

· Dominio de Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator y Premiere Pro, o de CapCut y Canva, o equivalentes.

· Experiencia en reels, TikTok e historias: guion, grabación (cámara o celular, iluminación y audio básico) y edición.

· Conocimiento de Meta Business Suite y de herramientas de programación de publicaciones.

· Buena ortografía y redacción para textos, subtítulos y copys.

· Disponibilidad para trabajar de forma presencial en el centro de Monterrey y para cubrir eventos según el calendario de la plaza.




Competencias

· Narrativa y criterio visual: convertir un negocio pequeño en una historia atractiva.

· Iniciativa: proponer ideas y producir con autonomía y presupuesto limitado.

· Trato cercano y respetuoso con locatarios, visitantes y equipo.

· Organización y cumplimiento de tiempos de entrega.

· Consistencia de marca y atención al detalle.

· Orientación a resultados medibles y mejora continua con base en métricas.




Se valorará adicionalmente

· Experiencia en centros comerciales, retail, gastronomía o marcas de consumo.

· Conocimiento de campañas en Meta Ads.

· Uso de herramientas de inteligencia artificial para diseño, edición y producción de contenido.

· Experiencia en cobertura de eventos y activaciones comerciales.




Postulación




Enviar CV y portafolio a urincon@inovert.mx

Head of Customer and Solutions Marketing at BairesDev




Head of Customer and Solutions Marketing at BairesDev

This is a hands-on leadership position where you'll turn our existing client base and our sales collateral into a genuine growth lever for the company. - 8+ years of overall B2B marketing experience, including 4+ years in a leadership role.

description:
Job Description

Information Technology Coordinator

What if your next role actually changed lives, including your own?

At EF Language Abroad, we believe that learning a language abroad is one of the most transformative experiences a person can have. And we need passionate, driven people to help make that happen. That's where you come in.

We're looking for an Information Technology Coordinator to join our team in Mexico City, Mexico. This is an entry level role for a curious, organized person who enjoys technology. You'll combine internal technical support with the automation of communication with customers and prospects, and you'll work closely with our IT operation, our Post Sales team, and demand generation.

Your work will directly shape the experience of students and their families, from the first contact to their return from the program. No two days look the same, just meaningful work, real impact, and a team that's genuinely rooting for you from day one.

Your Main Responsibilities

IT Support and Operations (30%)


 Handle basic technical incidents for the Post Sales team and, when applicable, other areas. 
 Manage user creation, removal, and permissions in the department's tools. 
 Follow up on incidents with corporate IT and external vendors. 
 Document processes, access, and configurations in step by step guides. 
 Support the preparation and validation of equipment and tools for the area's operations. 


Customer Journey Automation (part of the 70%)


 Design, build, and maintain automated communication journeys for students and families: confirmations, document reminders, pre departure follow up, welcome messages, check ins during the program, and post program surveys. 
 Configure email and SMS flows in the automation platform and in the CRM. 
 Segment audiences by program type (APP, ILS, LT), destination, and journey stage. 
 Monitor delivery, open, click, and conversion metrics, and propose improvements. 


Prospect Marketing Automation (part of the 70%)


 Build lead nurturing sequences, from the first inquiry to the close of the sale. 
 Coordinate with the Sales and Marketing teams on lead management and qualification within the CRM. 
 Support digital acquisition campaigns (email, social media, forms, and landing pages) in coordination with the central team. 
 Keep contact databases clean and up to date, in compliance with privacy and consent policies. 


Continuous Improvement and Reporting


 Prepare simple performance reports on journeys and campaigns with clear indicators. 
 Identify bottlenecks in Post Sales processes and propose automations that reduce them. 
 Take part in testing new tools and improving existing flows. 


Requirements

Education  and  Experience


 Bachelor's degree or technical degree in Systems, Computer Science, IT Engineering, Marketing, Digital Communication, or a related field (or student in the final semesters). 
 0 to 2 years of experience, preferably in technical support, internships, digital marketing, or automation. 


Languages


 Advanced English (B2 or above), spoken and written. Required to read technical documentation, work with central teams, and write communications in English for English speaking destinations. 
 Native Spanish. 


Technical Knowledge


 Solid knowledge of Office tools, including intermediate Excel (pivot tables, basic formulas, and VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP). 
 Medium to Advanced concepts of networks, operating systems, user directories, and incident resolution. 
 Interest in, and basic experience with, marketing automation or CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, or others). 
 Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS or email builders is desirable. 
 understanding of how AI is used in marketing and customer care (personalization, segmentation, automated responses). 


Skills


 Analytical thinking and results orientation. 
 Organization and the ability to work with changing priorities between high and low season . 




About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

About The Team

At EF Language Abroad, we believe that the world is better when people try to understand one another. Since 1965, we've helped millions of students discover new places, embrace diverse cultures, and gain fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to our mission of opening the world through education, harnessing the power of language learning to deepen the connection between people across the globe.

We offer immersive short-term and long-term language courses and programs across different languages in the countries where they’re spoken. Through blending classroom-based lessons with interactive exercises and real-world practice, our courses bring you to the heart of the language. Together, our global staff help students from around the world develop the language skills they need to achieve their dreams.

EF is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults. All positions are subject to a criminal background and/or reference checks, as applicable.

description:
About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja 

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Position Overview

The next big idea can start with a conversation. What are consumers talking about? What’s gaining momentum? What signals are hiding beneath the surface?

We're seeking a Manager, Social Analytics to lead social analytics for Mexico, Brazil, and the growing LATAM market, reporting into the Sr. Director, Social Analytics. This role blends deep social media fluency with 2026-caliber analytics and a genuine curiosity for AI-powered workflows, pairing solid data fundamentals with a growing use of AI agents to surface what matters faster.

At SharkNinja, our Social Analytics teams go deeper to understand the conversations, culture, and consumer behaviors shaping what comes next. In this role, you'll translate fast-moving social signals into actionable insights that can inform regional growth and help identify the next viral SharkNinja product.

You'll manage a stakeholder group spanning regional and global partners, serving as a trusted analytics partner across social, marketing, creative, agencies, and senior leadership. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable working directly with data and communicating what it means — bringing analytical rigor, speed, curiosity, and clarity to a fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities


Social Media Analytics: Lead reporting and insights across all social media activity (organic, earned, influencer, and paid) for Mexico, Brazil, and the growing LATAM market; quantify what drives virality and raise the odds of it happening.
Regional Market Focus: Serve as the primary analytics partner for the region, bringing analytical rigor and scalable social measurement. Partner closely with regional social, marketing, and agency leaders.
AI-Driven Insight Generation: Direct the use of AI agents against social and marketing data to surface signal faster — orchestrating intelligent tools against good data, not manual reporting.
Make Data Actionable: Provide fast, actionable analysis to inform regional growth and the next viral SharkNinja product.
Stakeholder Management: Serve as the go-to analytics partner across a broad and growing set of stakeholders — regional social and marketing leaders, creative, agencies, and senior leadership — managing competing priorities with clarity and poise.
KPI Development: Cut through the noise of vanity metrics and define clear, outcome-oriented KPIs — metrics that ladder up to what we're actually here to do: sell products, yes, but more specifically, delight the consumers who use them.
Executive Reporting: Deliver tailored, action-oriented reporting for regional and global stakeholders, automating recurring outputs where possible.
Best Practices & Benchmarks: Conduct rapid analyses to establish benchmarks and evolve measurement approaches for the region.


Attributes & Skills


Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Marketing, or a related field required; Master's degree a plus.
6+ years of experience in marketing analytics or social media analytics.
Experience with SQL and modern data platforms such as Snowflake; comfort with AI-assisted analytics tools and agentic workflows a plus.
Solid analytical and spreadsheet fundamentals paired with genuine curiosity about AI-powered and agentic workflows — someone who can work the data directly and is eager to use AI to get to insight faster.
Strong track record analyzing social platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.) and translating insights into clear business and creative actions.
Self-motivated and comfortable managing ambiguity and multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Fluency in Spanish and English is required.


Work Environment

This is a primarily on-site role based in Mexico City, Mexico, with flexibility to work from home 1–2 days per week.

"This role blends deep social media fluency with 2026-caliber analytics and a genuine curiosity for AI-powered workflows, pairing solid data fundamentals with a growing use of AI agents to surface what matters faster. You'll manage a stakeholder group spanning regional and global partners, translating fast-moving social signal into action for all of them."

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day. Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

We’re a globally distributed team of 200+ people across 15+ countries and 3 continents, on a mission to expand real opportunity for women in LATAM.




Why we’re opening this role




We’re opening this role to make candidate generation more consistent as Viva’s hiring needs grow. We need a builder-minded manager who can set up and drive a recruitment marketing strategy, using social media, paid campaigns, and other channels to attract qualified candidates and help us broaden our mission to empower more women in LATAM to access meaningful job opportunities.

Create and coordinate content: Develop original organic social content and coordinate staff- or influencer-generated content initiatives as relevant.

Requirements

TikTok's Global Business Solutions (GBS) regional sales and advertising teams drive revenue growth by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding clients, and running campaigns that deliver measurable results.

Client needs, market trends, and performance expectations shift constantly, and differently in every market. We build strategy accordingly, turning those moving pieces into advertising solutions that work and client partnerships that last.

You will help businesses grow on a global platform, working on the campaigns and relationships that turn advertisers into long-term partners.

The GBS team at TikTok partners with leading advertisers to drive strategic business growth through innovative and effective marketing solutions. We are committed to delivering best-in-class support and insights that empower our clients to achieve meaningful results. As we expand TikTok Shop in the region, we are looking for a passionate and strategic Brand Partnership Manager to accelerate adoption and success of TikTok Shop Ads within our top enterprise and mid-market accounts.

As a Brand Partnership Manager focused on TikTok Shop, you will play a critical role in driving revenue, leading strategic conversations with clients, and positioning TikTok Shop Ads as a core solution in our ecosystem. You will act as a trusted consultant to clients and cross-functional teams, helping brands integrate commerce and media strategies, unlock performance opportunities, and scale their businesses through TikTok Shop.
Success in this role requires a strong mix of strategic thinking, client-centricity, sales acumen, and a deep understanding of eCommerce dynamics.

Responsibilities
- Lead strategic relationships with enterprise clients, with a focus on TikTok Shop adoption and commerce media strategy.
- Act as a subject matter expert in TikTok Shop Ads, educating clients and internal stakeholders on product capabilities, best practices, and roadmap developments.
- Collaborate closely with Client Solutions Managers (CSMs), Product Marketing, and e-Commerce teams to deliver high-impact solutions and integrated media plans.
- Identify key growth opportunities within your client portfolio and develop tailored activation plans to maximize Shop Ads usage and performance.
- Analyze campaign performance and business data to inform strategy, provide actionable recommendations, and build compelling narratives.
- Stay ahead of market trends, competitor offerings, and category movements to proactively guide client strategy and drive innovation.
- Champion feedback loops with Product and cross-functional teams, sharing insights from clients to improve TikTok Shop solutions.
- Participate in internal knowledge sharing initiatives, contributing to case studies, learning sessions, and strategic alignment across teams.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- 5+ years of experience in digital advertising, eCommerce, or media sales.
- Proven success in managing complex client relationships and delivering consultative, data-driven solutions.
- Strong understanding of eCommerce ecosystem, performance marketing, and retail media strategies.
- Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
- Ability to influence and build trust with high-level stakeholders.
- High written and oral proficiency in Spanish and English is required due to frequent communications with stakeholders based in Spanish-Speaking markets.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience working with commerce or marketplace platforms (e.g., Amazon, Mercado Libre, Shopee, etc.)
- Experience in selling or managing performance-based ad products.
- Strong analytical skills and familiarity with auction-based media buying.
- Self-starter mindset with adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (e.g., product, marketing, analytics).

*In-Office Policy* - Please note we're working in the office 5x a week. As a global company, we have flexible working hours.

Please submit your CV in English in order to be considered.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

description:
Description

Amazon Advertising operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of advertising solutions. We partner with advertisers to reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com, across our other owned and operated sites, on other high quality sites across the web, and on millions of devices. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing organization working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.

We’re looking for a results oriented Sales Account Manager who is passionate about partnering with our advertisers, educating them and helping to solve ambiguous business problems, mitigating risks before they become roadblocks. As a Sales Account Manager, you manage and deliver against complex advertiser goals and problems to drive revenue and achieve revenue targets. You nurture customer relationships and create revenue opportunities from the advertisers you own. description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Role Summary

Job Description

Global SEO Project Lead

You will report to: Manager , Global Digital Demand center

Location: Monterrey , Nuevoo Leon

The Global SEO Project Lead is an experienced individual contributor responsible for managing global Search Engine Optimization (SEO) programs across Rockwell Automation's digital products.

You will be the primary internal liaison between Rockwell Automation partners, the strategic SEO agency partner, and Web and technical teams. It prioritizes SEO opportunities properly, translates them into actionable requirements, implements them accurately, and completes them on schedule.

Working with the strategic agency partner, the SEO Project Manager collaborates on SEO research, audits, and analysis. This partner also develops optimization recommendations. The SEO Project Manager provides internal business context, establishes priorities, manages deliverables, and inspires these recommendations through implementation. You will be Rockwell Automation's internal SEO subject matter expert (SME), helping team members understand SEO requirements and ensuring agency recommendations align with business, portfolio, industry, and digital priorities.

You will operate with moderate autonomy and be accountable for project coordination, team member agreement, agency management, implementation tracking, and performance reporting across multiple concurrent SEO projects.

We ask that you working knowledge of traditional SEO and new Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). Additionally, it requires knowledge of Master of Laws optimization. However, you will do not independently own global digital strategy or direct reports.

Scope of Responsibility

Decision-Making Scope


Manage SEO projects within established digital marketing, Web, and content strategies.
Prioritize agency SEO recommendations based on growth, feasibility, and organizational priorities.
Make daily decisions regarding SEO project deliverables, dependencies, and implementation priorities.
Escalate major strategic, technical, resource, or funding decisions.


Influence


Be an primary internal SEO SME and agency liaison, connecting SEO strategy and recommendations with business and technical execution.
Ensures recommendations are understood, prioritized, implemented, and measured to influence SEO outcomes.
Advise team members on SEO, AEO, GEO, and AI-search best practices.
Build agreement across agency, Marketing, Web, Portfolio, Industry, and regional teams.
Drive accountability for SEO deliverables without direct authority over participating teams.


Complexity


Manage multiple concurrent SEO projects involving agency partners and team members.
Coordinate dependencies across Marketing, content owners, Portfolio, Industry, Analytics, and regional teams.
Translate technical SEO recommendations into clear our requirements and applicable workstreams.
Balances stakeholder priorities, technical dependencies, agency recommendations, and implementation timelines.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Agency Partnership & SEO Management


Serve as the primary day-to-day partner for Rockwell Automation's strategic SEO agency, providing business context, priorities, requirements, and feedback.
Manage agency SEO deliverables, including audits, keyword research, competitive analysis, technical recommendations, content recommendations, and performance insights.
Review agency recommendations to ensure they align with Rockwell Automation our goals, digital priorities, and website strategy.
Translate agency findings into prioritized internal projects, requirements, and implementation plans.
Maintain clear ownership, timelines, and next steps for agency recommendations and deliverables.
Ensure agency work progresses from analysis and recommendation through internal implementation and measurement.


Project Management & Implementation


Be the central liaison between the SEO agency, team members, SMEs, Web teams, and technical development teams.
Coordinate implementation of approved SEO recommendations across content, Web, and technical workstreams.
Translate SEO recommendations into clear, applicable requirements for non-SEO stakeholders and technical teams.
Manage project timelines, dependencies, approvals, and implementation status to ensure work is completed and promptly.
Identify and resolve blockers that could delay SEO implementation.
Validate that completed work aligns with SEO requirements and coordinate with the agency when you require additional review or QA.
Manage SEO activities associated with website launches, migrations, redesigns, and major content updates.


SEO Subject Matter Expertise & Stakeholder Enablement


Serve as an internal SEO subject matter expert, providing guidance to Marketing, Web, Portfolio, Industry, and regional stakeholders.
Educate stakeholders on SEO requirements and translate technical concepts into clear business implications and actions.
Provide SEO consultation during website and content planning to ensure search considerations are incorporated early in the development process.
Advocate for SEO best practices and help teams understand how their work impacts organic and AI-search visibility.
Develop and maintain SEO documentation, templates, workflows, and best-practice guidance.


AEO, AEO & Emerging Search


Partner with the strategic SEO agency to evaluate emerging search trends across AEO, AEO, AI Overviews, and LLM platforms.
Translate emerging search recommendations into practical actions for content, Web, and technical teams.
Coordinate implementation of structured, easily extractable content—including FAQs, benefits, comparisons, and solution-focused content—to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search.
Help stakeholders understand how evolving search behaviors impact content and website requirements.
Incorporate traditional SEO and emerging AI-search considerations into priority optimization projects.


Performance Measurement & Reporting


Partner with the SEO agency and Analytics teams to monitor organic search and AI-search performance.
Own quarterly business review (QBR) reporting by accurately collecting, validating, and analyzing SEO performance data. Ensure data integrity through rigorous QA. Develop actionable insights. Present clear, compelling performance narratives and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
Track progress against SEO priorities, implementation roadmaps, and established KPIs.
Translate agency reporting and performance data into clear insights, business implications, and recommended next steps for stakeholders.
Communicate SEO progress, results, risks, and opportunities through regular stakeholder and leadership updates.
Document project outcomes and learnings to support continuous improvement and future optimization efforts.


Operational Excellence


Establish and maintain clear workflows for moving SEO recommendations from agency analysis → stakeholder alignment → Web/technical implementation → QA → measurement.
Maintain project documentation and implementation trackers to ensure visibility and accountability.
Work within project management frameworks such as Jira to manage SEO tasks, timelines, dependencies, and delivery status.
Identify opportunities to improve collaboration between the SEO agency and internal teams.
Develop repeatable processes that increase the speed and consistency of SEO implementation across the organization.


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Marketing, Business, or equivalent professional experience.
6+ years of experience in SEO, digital project management, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience managing agency partners and cross-functional digital projects.
Strong working knowledge of SEO principles, including on-page, content, technical SEO, internal linking, and keyword strategy.
Strong project management skills with demonstrated ability to manage timelines, dependencies, stakeholders, and deliverables.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to translate technical recommendations into clear business requirements and stakeholder actions.
Experience with SEO and analytics platforms such as SEMrush, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics, and/or GA4.
Working familiarity with project management tools such as Jira.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience managing SEO agency relationships and deliverables.
Experience coordinating SEO implementation with Web development and technical teams.
Experience supporting enterprise-scale or global websites.
Experience in B2B, manufacturing, technology, or Industrial Automation environments.
Familiarity with AEO, GEO, AI Overviews, and LLM optimization.
Experience working in a matrixed global organization.
Working knowledge of technical SEO, structured data/schema, CMS platforms, HTML, and website architecture.


Core Competencies


Agency and partner management
Cross-functional project management
SEO subject matter expertise
Stakeholder management and influence
Ability to translate technical recommendations into actionable requirements
Strong organization, prioritization, and follow-through
Ability to drive projects through completion without direct authority

Experienced in integrated Marketing and Communication with a strong foundation in digital.

High degree of initiative and pro-active management

100% remote work, forever.

Role Title: Research Marketing Lead (Remote)
Role Type: Full-time

The Role

We’re looking for a Research Marketing Lead to own how our research, benchmarks, and technical work are positioned, launched, and adopted across the AI ecosystem.




You’ll work closely with our research team to turn technical work into high-impact launches that earn attention, adoption, and citations. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our research and methodology, shape positioning and narratives, establish a high quality bar for publication, and build go-to-market strategies that put our work in front of the right researchers, developers, AI labs, and technical audiences.




What You'll Do

1. Own research GTM end-to-end, developing launch and distribution strategies for research, benchmarks, evaluations, and other technical work.

2. Establish the publication-readiness bar for research and benchmarks, partnering with researchers to ensure methodology, claims, results, and supporting materials are rigorous, clear, and defensible before launch.

3. Develop positioning and narratives that translate complex technical findings into clear, differentiated stories without sacrificing technical accuracy or depth.

4. Identify high-impact research opportunities by understanding emerging AI trends, open questions, competitive research, and what matters to researchers and practitioners.

5. Shape research packaging and distribution, including research pages, benchmark releases, technical content, launch materials, and other assets that drive discovery and usage.

6. Build relationships across the AI research ecosystem, including researchers, AI labs, developers, technical communities, and influential practitioners.

7. Drive adoption of our research and benchmarks, identifying the audiences, communities, and channels most likely to use, reference, and build on our work.

8. Measure research impact, tracking adoption, citations, engagement, usage, and qualitative feedback to understand what resonates and where our work is creating value.

9. Create feedback loops between the market and research, bringing ecosystem insights back to the research team to inform future benchmarks, evaluations, and research priorities.




What We're Looking For

1. Experience marketing, launching, or driving adoption of technical research, AI/ML products, developer products, benchmarks, evaluations, or similarly complex technical work.

2. Strong track record developing and executing go-to-market strategies for technical audiences.

3. Ability to deeply understand technical work and translate it into clear, credible, differentiated positioning and narratives.

4. Strong understanding of the AI/ML research ecosystem, including major labs, research trends, benchmarks, evaluations, and technical communities.

5. Exceptional written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical and broader audiences.

6. Strong analytical judgment and the ability to evaluate whether technical claims, supporting evidence, and research materials are ready for external publication.

7. Experience building relationships with researchers, technical leaders, developers, or AI communities.

8. High ownership and the ability to take ambiguous initiatives from strategy through execution.

9. Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to work closely with researchers while maintaining a high bar for technical accuracy and quality.




Preferred

Description

We are looking for a product leader that can inspire a team of creative product managers to improve the experience for customers, vendors and sellers in Mexico and Brazil.

The role will be critical to achieve business results in MX and BR. You will work closely with business and engineering leaders to set the vision, goals and deliver a better experience.

A day in the life

This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for technology solutions serving BR and MX. Day-to-day, you define requirements, prioritize the backlog, and drive execution with engineering, design, and science teams. You partner with business leaders, operations, and finance stakeholders to align technology investments with business outcomes. Your customers are internal teams and external sellers or vendors. You solve problems around scalability, localization, and closing capability gaps needed for vendors and selelrs to be successful. You write narratives, help the team find requriements, analyze metrics, and make trade-off decisions across competing priorities.

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

description:
Employee Outreach & Engagement Coordinator 

Tijuana, Baja California | Full-Time | On-Site 




Position Summary 

Superlanet is seeking an outgoing, creative, and highly organized Employee Outreach & Engagement Coordinator to strengthen our presence in the Tijuana community while fostering a positive, engaging, and collaborative workplace experience for our employees. 




This position will play an important role in building relationships with universities, colleges, technical schools, and professional communities in both Mexico and the United States. The coordinator will actively participate in recruiting activities, identify potential candidates, connect with students and recent graduates, and help promote career opportunities at Superlanet. 




Additionally, this individual will work closely with employees and leadership to coordinate internal activities, support employee engagement initiatives, and contribute to building a welcoming and positive workplace culture. 




Ideal Candidate 

The ideal candidate is personable, proactive, resourceful, and passionate about recruiting and building professional relationships. They are comfortable communicating with university representatives, students, recent graduates, and experienced professionals. 




The candidate should enjoy connecting with people, identifying potential talent, conducting recruiting outreach, and representing Superlanet at university events and career fairs. 




Strong communication, organizational, networking, and follow-up skills are essential. The ability to communicate professionally with individuals in both the United States and Mexico is required. 




Fluency in both English and Spanish is required, including strong verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively with our U.S. and Mexico-based teams.

El reto principal es definir y liderar la implementación de las estrategias y planes de acción para la atracción e inscripción de alumnos de nuevo ingreso a profesional y preparatoria, con el propósito de garantizar el logro de las metas de nuevos ingresos y calidad académica.

Asignar metas claras y retadoras a cada integrante del equipo en cada una de las etapas del proceso de inscripción de los alumnos aspirantes, así como dar seguimiento al avance y resultados de cada integrante del equipo evaluándolo en base a las metas previamente establecidas.




¿Qué buscamos? 

Si tienes formación profesional y estudios de Maestría en Administración, Mercadotecnia, Ingeniería Industrial, Comunicación o áreas afines; cuentas con al menos 4 años de experiencia en atracción de alumnos, planeación de ventas, ventas estratégicas y servicio al cliente, organización de eventos o relaciones Públicas y cuentas con habilidades como liderazgo, enfoque a objetivos y colaboración ¡te estamos buscando, postúlate ya!
